key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as traders priced in further RBA rate hikes, with mortgage rates hitting a one-year high and home loan applications down 15% since the federal budget
Aussie banks forecast the largest house price falls on record, signalling a potential housing correction that will pressure construction and REIT sectors
Iron ore market faces a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict, while Macarthur Resources cleared a WA bulk test hurdle
Beetaloo gas project debate intensifies between energy security and climate concerns; TMK Energy gas rates surged on Mongolian drilling
Bathla's collapse exposes systemic fragility in Australia's construction sector, with ratings agencies also flagging Victoria's soaring debt
Fed's Waller signalled a September hold, supporting global risk assets; however 65 months of above-target inflation complicates the disinflation narrative
EV sales surpassed petrol cars in Australia for the first time, while Volkswagen announced 50,000 job cuts globally
ASIC launched a review of whistleblower complaints at major accounting firms, raising governance concerns across ASX-listed entities

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces a structural shakeout obscured by war-driven demand; small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) showing relative strength; gold producers (Aurum, Lake Victoria Gold) benefiting from safe-haven flows
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face margin pressure from iron ore consolidation; small-cap exploration names offer speculative upside but carry elevated risk; gold equities (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) supported by geopolitical uncertainty

sectors.trend: Mortgage rates at one-year highs; home loan applications down 15% since budget; banks forecast record house price falls; CBA and Westpac under scrutiny for fee structures on loyal customers
sectors.implications: NIM pressure on CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX as rate cycle peaks; credit quality risk rising with housing correction; fee-related regulatory risk could pressure margins; defensive dividend appeal remains but growth outlook weakens

sectors.trend: Beetaloo gas project polarises markets between energy security and climate risk; TMK Energy gas rates surged; energy transition costs mounting and 'running off the rails'; AI-driven electricity demand straining grid capacity
sectors.implications: SGL.AX, WDS.AX, XVG.AX benefit from gas demand narrative; renewable names face cost overruns; grid infrastructure plays (incumbent utilities) gain from AI power demand; Beetaloo outcome is a binary catalyst for LNG equities

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse signals sector-wide fragility; housing construction expected to follow falling prices; Melbourne councils admit inability to cope with planned population growth; Victoria debt flagged by ratings agencies
sectors.implications: CGP.AX, WBC.AX construction exposure at risk; REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and cap-rate pressure; infrastructure names (WES.AX, WPG.AX) may benefit from public spending shifts; avoid speculative construction plays

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble, shifting demand toward tablet alternatives; EV adoption accelerating in Australia; VW cutting 50,000 jobs globally
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (pharma retail) may see mix shifts; EV transition benefits battery and charging infrastructure names; consumer staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX) offer defensive stability amid rate uncertainty

sectors.trend: Nvidia signals AI boom continues; AI electricity demand outpacing grid build-out; skilled migrant shortage in AI and trades
sectors.implications: ASX-listed tech exposure limited but benefits via BHP.AX (digital mining), CSL.AX (AI in biotech); grid and power infrastructure names gain; watch for ASX-listed AI-adjacent plays

key_themes: RBA rate path uncertainty: economy 'limping' but inflation sticky; RBA may pause before further hikes
Housing correction risk: record house price falls forecast, 15% drop in loan applications, construction following prices down
Iron ore structural shakeout: war masking supply/demand rebalancing; Macarthur WA test a positive micro signal
Energy transition cost overruns: Beetaloo debate, grid strain from AI, mounting transition costs
Construction sector fragility: Bathla collapse as systemic warning; Victoria debt concerns
Global disinflation vs. 65-month above-target inflation tension; Fed September hold likely
EV adoption inflection point in Australia; legacy auto disruption (VW 50k cuts)
ASIC governance review of Big Four accounting firms – potential ASX compliance ripple

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA further rate hikes despite weak growth
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA statements; favour rate-sensitive defensives (WES.AX, WOW.AX); reduce leverage in rate-sensitive REITs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and credit deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight banks' mortgage book exposure; avoid construction equities; favour cash and short-duration bonds
Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure (FMG.AX, BHP.AX iron ore segment); favour gold and diversified miners

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy transition cost overruns and Beetaloo policy risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge LNG exposure; monitor government policy signals on Beetaloo; favour established gas producers over speculative renewables
Avoid small-cap construction and property developers; favour large-cap infrastructure (WES.AX, WPG.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: ASIC governance review of accounting firms
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor for ASX-listed entities relying on affected audit firms; no immediate portfolio action required

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and diversified miners amid iron ore shakeout and geopolitical risk
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore structural rebalancing pressures pure-play miners; gold benefits from safe-haven demand and 65-month inflation overhang

opportunities.recommendation: Add gas and energy infrastructure exposure ahead of Beetaloo resolution and AI-driven power demand
opportunities.rationale: TMK gas rate surge, Beetaloo debate, and AI grid strain create multi-year demand tailwinds for gas and power infrastructure

opportunities.recommendation: Position in consumer staples and healthcare defensives ahead of potential RBA pause
opportunities.rationale: Economy limping, housing correction risk, and rate uncertainty favour low-beta, high-dividend names

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap mining exposure on positive assay/test results
opportunities.rationale: Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals showing relative strength; Macarthur WA test cleared

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to banks and construction/REITs amid housing correction and rate pressure
defensive_moves.rationale: Record house price fall forecasts, 15% loan application drop, Bathla contagion risk, and Victoria debt concerns

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge iron ore concentration risk in large-cap mining
defensive_moves.rationale: Structural iron ore shakeout masked by war; Macarthur test suggests supply additions; FMG and BHP iron ore segments at risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash allocation and short-duration bonds as RBA path remains uncertain
defensive_moves.rationale: Economy limping but inflation sticky; RBA may pause but 65-month above-target inflation limits downside; Fed hold supports global liquidity

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to modestly lower over 1–3 months. RBA pause expected but not confirmed; mortgage rate pressure and housing data will dominate. Fed September hold supports global risk sentiment. Iron ore volatility and Beetaloo policy signals create sector rotation. Construction sector weakness may spill into broader sentiment.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pauses and housing stabilises. 'Bull case returns' narrative gains traction if disinflation accelerates. Energy transition and AI power demand create structural winners. However, iron ore shakeout and potential housing correction cap upside. Australia's per-capita growth lagging Canada is a structural concern.
